# Spoken 0.2.3 — Test Build 17
Own dictation modes, a project page and one place for everything that needs attention.
## Changes
- **Your own dictation modes.** Settings › Dictation › Modes lists Raw and your modes. Create, rename, edit and delete them; each can use its own provider and model, and **Test** runs a mode on a spoken sample without inserting anything. Clean and Concise keep your prompts, **To English** is new, and Structured is gone (a shortcut that used it switches to Raw). The dictation history shows which mode each entry used. - **Project page.** Clicking a project shows two cards: its **About** text, written in Markdown and shown formatted, and its **flows** as a graph. It fits a split view too. Each result says whether its document exists for the chosen meeting: click to open it, or to create it. The sidebar lists only the meetings under a project, and new projects ask what they are about instead of creating a README. Agents see the About text. - **Needs attention.** A bell at the top right of the window lists what is misconfigured — a flow using a deleted provider, a provider that can't be reached, a dictation mode that can't run — and each entry jumps to where it is fixed. The menu bar shows "… need attention" only when something does. - **Flows.** After a meeting every flow of the project is offered; "Preselect after meetings" decides which start checked. The flow editor names its default model and lists a provider's models as soon as it is picked.
## Update an existing installation
In **Spoken**, choose **Check for Updates…**, or use the sidebar update action when it appears. Download, install and allow Spoken to restart. The installed version afterwards should be **0.2.3 (17)**. Finish any recording or dictation before installing, and save pending document edits when asked.
Builds 9 and newer can receive this update. Existing library content is preserved. Older pre-library builds remain excluded from this update channel.
## Fresh installation
Download the DMG, drag **Spoken** to **Applications**, eject the DMG, then open Spoken from Applications. This is the release app, not Spoken Dev. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac; macOS 15 or newer is the supported test target.
This test build is **ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized**. macOS may require **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** on first launch. Permissions may need to be granted again. In-app update archives are authenticated with Sparkle's EdDSA signature.
## Validation and limitations
The automated regression suite and packaged artifact are checked before publication. The real update from 0.2.2 on the second Mac remains a user acceptance test. The library remains local and unencrypted.

# Spoken 0.2.2 — Test Build 16
A setup, dictation and agent update for the Spoken 0.2 workbench.
## Changes
- New first-launch setup in four steps in the main window: permissions in one list with explanations, the built-in speech model, a first dictation from the menu bar, and a summary. A Get Started checklist in the sidebar covers the optional next steps: connect an agent, record a meeting, add text and screenshot models. - Added **Exxperts** as an agent client. Spoken writes its connector with the profile's key directly into Exxperts' MCP configuration, never through the clipboard. - Clean, Concise and Structured no longer lose a dictation when no text provider is set up or the provider fails. The raw text is inserted and an orange notice says why, with a button to the provider settings. Cleanup gives up after 60 seconds without any response instead of ten minutes, and cancelling keeps the dictation and its audio in the history. - Dictation errors and the transcript preview grow out of the notch instead of hiding behind it. - The speech model starts loading as soon as a dictation starts, so the first dictation after a pause is faster. - A tidier menu bar menu: meeting recording on its own, then the last dictation, Dictation Mode and Dictation Options. "Nothing heard" explains how the shortcut works.

# Spoken 0.2.1 — Test Build 15
A security and reliability update for the Spoken 0.2 workbench.
## Changes
- Secured Markdown and diagram rendering against injected scripts and unwanted network requests. Diagrams, timestamp links and native document actions remain available. - Kept the original dictation when text cleanup fails. Retry Cleanup uses the same captured text; Insert Raw explicitly inserts the original transcript. Recovery updates the existing history entry rather than creating duplicates. - Fixed **Spoken beenden** in the screen-recording permission step: the wizard closes before the normal app quit request. Recording and unsaved-document protections remain active; forced termination is not used. - Added Back navigation in setup and an explicit already-allowed permission screen when reviewing previous steps. Visible permission screens refresh their status while Spoken is active.
## Update an existing installation
In **Spoken**, choose **Check for Updates…**, or use the sidebar update action when it appears. Download, install and allow Spoken to restart. The installed version afterwards should be **0.2.1 (15)**. Finish any recording or dictation before installing, and save pending document edits when asked.
